plugins.name: dev-in-a-box
plugins.description: Developer role: spec analysis, tech lead routing and stack-specialist developers (Python, Java, Android, React).

plugins.name: po-in-a-box
plugins.description: Product Owner role: refining requests into testable requirements and deciding acceptance of delivered work.

plugins.name: business-in-a-box
plugins.description: Business Analyst role: establishing whether a thing is worth doing: value, cost, risk and the numbers behind them.

plugins.name: security-in-a-box
plugins.description: Security Reviewer role: finding and ranking security risk in a design or change, and saying what would close each risk.

plugins.name: marketing-in-a-box
plugins.description: Marketer role: turning what the product is into positioning and content a defined audience will understand and act on.

plugins.name: lawyer-in-a-box
plugins.description: Legal Counsel role: identifying legal and contractual risk in a document, product or plan, and stating it in plain language.

plugins.name: support-in-a-box
plugins.description: Support Agent role: resolving or correctly routing a customer issue with an answer that is accurate and kind.

plugins.name: infra-in-a-box
plugins.description: Infra Engineer and IaC specialists (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Puppet): reproducible environments with reviewed previews and gated applies.

plugins.name: qa-in-a-box
plugins.description: QA role: black-box testing of a running application against its test plan, within a declared scope.

plugins.name: docs-in-a-box
plugins.description: Documentation role: documentation and changelog for an approved delivery.

plugins.name: model-router-in-a-box
plugins.description: Chooses the model for each flow node from the agent host in use.

plugins.name: orchestrator-in-a-box
plugins.description: Connects role plugins into user-defined flows on demand.

plugins.name: observability-in-a-box
plugins.description: Observability Engineer and Reader: instrumenting tools and the deploy stack (logs, metrics, traces, APM, alerts) and reading the signals.

plugins.name: architect-in-a-box
plugins.description: Solution Architect role and cloud specialists: AWS, GCP, Azure, Proxmox and VMware designs with service-level knowledge, platform comparison and decision records.

plugins.name: finops-in-a-box
plugins.description: FinOps roles: cost estimates from provider calculators and pricing APIs, budget planning from scope and complexity, budgets and alerts, and cost monitoring.

plugins.name: disaster-recovery-in-a-box
plugins.description: Disaster recovery roles: business impact analysis, RPO and RTO targets, recovery strategy and runbooks, ISO and framework mapping, and recovery test design and review.

plugins.name: governance-in-a-box
plugins.description: Governance roles: policies and exceptions, risk register and appetite, control audit across security, privacy, data and AI frameworks, and decision rights with a traceable decision log.

plugins.name: agile-in-a-box
plugins.description: Agile ceremonies, issue writing, estimation, backlog prioritisation, flow metrics and working agreements.

plugins.name: dba-in-a-box
plugins.description: dba role.

plugins.name: release-in-a-box
plugins.description: release role.

plugins.name: postmortem-in-a-box
plugins.description: Postmortem role: blameless postmortems for outages, escaped defects, vulnerabilities and attacks.

plugins.name: research-in-a-box
plugins.description: Research role: sourced research with a baseline and a diff on refresh.

plugins.name: curator-in-a-box
plugins.description: Curator role: integrating or updating a skill in the plugin tree.
